visual_review.summary: Attempt-018 fixes the prior bottom-crop issue and produces a clean, centered, full-bottle serum product image with a blank brandable label, coherent gold dropper, amber serum body, and soft studio reflection. It is strong enough to enter human approval or production-candidate review, while final brand delivery would still need brand-specific label/art-direction work.

bottom margin and reflection are present, resolving the earlier crop problem
single centered bottle reads as a usable ecommerce beauty product hero image
blank satin label area is large and brandable with no readable text or logo hallucination
gold cap, frosted glass, amber serum, and studio background are visually coherent

cap highlight is strong and slightly stylized but acceptable for premium cosmetic presentation
